title: Expense & Spending Log Spreadsheet Template | Daily Tracker (Excel/Google Sheets)
description_html:
Take control of your finances with this easy-to-use Expense & Spending Log Spreadsheet Template! Whether you are trying to stick to a monthly budget, track daily spending habits, or simply want to know where your hard-earned cash is going, this tracker is your perfect companion. Fully editable and compatible with both Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, you can customize the categories to fit your unique lifestyle.

Features include a daily expense logger, a monthly summary dashboard, and a recurring bills tracker. Each tab is designed with clean, usable columns so you can start organizing your money immediately. No complicated formulas to learn—just type in your numbers and let the spreadsheet do the heavy lifting with auto-calculating totals.

This is a digital instant download for personal use only. You will receive a PDF with the Google Sheets link and an Excel file upon purchase. Start tracking your expenses today and reach your financial goals faster!
